title: Build the two matched sides
text: Label left/right and front/rear posts viewed from the front. Set side rail bottoms at 90 / 490 / 890 / 1290 mm from the finished feet; upper rail starts at 1690 mm / 66.535 in. Seat two 8 mm / 0.315 in dowels per rail end. Rail end bores are thickness-centred; lower rail height offsets are 20 / 50 mm; upper offsets 20 / 72 mm. Drill 26 mm / 1.024 in deep for 25 mm / 0.984 in nominal embed in each member. Dry-fit, glue, clamp flat and square; matched side depth 350 mm / 13.780 in.

title: Fit the repeated exterior Xs
text: Make 8 complementary pairs of slats. Clamp a scrap jig with end planes 400 mm / 15.748 in apart and outside edges 240 mm / 9.449 in apart. End cuts are parallel, 26.66 degrees off square. Finished long-edge length 447.59 mm / 17.622 in; use 490 mm / 19.291 in rough blanks. Mark the intersection rhombus and remove 9 mm / 0.354 in from opposite faces. Test before batch cutting. End planes are 125 / 525 / 925 / 1325 / 1725 mm. One K5 screw per end, centred across each slat and 20 mm / 0.787 in vertically in from the cut plane. Clamp, pilot and drive flush. Glue only a well-fitted lap.

title: Install the inward shelf cleats
text: Keep G tops level with the B tops at 160 / 560 / 960 / 1360 mm. Cleats project 30 mm / 1.181 in into the opening. At each cleat drive K3 from its inside face toward B, at y = 110 / 175 / 240 mm and 15 mm / 0.591 in below its top. Do not move screws onto the X end screw lines. Check straightness and full bearing.

title: Connect sides with the two aprons
text: Use a helper. Maintain 810 mm / 31.890 in between inner post faces and 900 mm / 35.433 in across the frame. Aprons occupy z = 1690–1782 mm; outer faces flush to front/rear posts. Two 6 mm / 0.236 in dowels per apron end: thickness centre 9 mm / 0.354 in, height offsets 20 / 72 mm. Drill 21 mm / 0.827 in deep for 20 mm / 0.787 in embed in each member. Dry-fit, glue and clamp square. Keep temporary support until cured and back bracing is installed.

title: Secure the shelves and separate top
text: Shelf underside levels: 160 / 560 / 960 / 1360 mm; tops: 178 / 578 / 978 / 1378 mm. Maintain 0.5 mm / 0.020 in side clearance and 1 mm / 0.039 in front/rear setback. Four K4 per shelf: x = 60 / 840, y = 90 / 260 mm. Clearance-drill the shelf, pilot the cleat and countersink flush. Centre the top for 10 mm / 0.394 in overhang from the frame. Fix two K8 angles to the inner face of each apron at x = 247.5 / 652.5 mm. Use one K9 into the apron and one into the top per angle. Actual fitting is the drill template; verify tips cannot emerge.

title: Brace the rear and anchor to the wall
text: Square the case. Rear strap anchors are at post centres x = 22.5 / 877.5 mm and z = 125 / 1725 mm. Target hole pitch 1814.12 mm / 71.422 in; leave 25 mm / 0.984 in beyond each end hole. Drill clearance 5.5 mm / 0.217 in; deburr. Fit J-1 against the back, J-2 behind it with K7 washers at both ends. Use K6; snug without bowing the case. Fit two manufacturer-selected wall restraints near z = 1750 mm / 68.898 in. Avoid bores and concealed services; verify actual wall structure and screw paths. Do not load before restraint installation.

title: Finish, level and inspect before use
text: Ease accessible edges, sand to the finish maker’s guidance and keep glue faces clean. Cure all adhesive and finish fully. Fit equal non-slip pads and confirm four-foot bearing without rocking. Check every joint, shelf bearing, exposed screw and steel edge. Recheck restraints after relocation. Place heavier contents low; do not climb or sit on shelves. No safe working load has been established.
